hooks.command: mkdir -p kb/.logs && echo "[$(date -Iseconds)] Session started" >> kb/.logs/session.log 2>/dev/null || true
if [[ -d kb ]]; then jq -r '"[" + (now | todate) + "] " + .tool_name + ": " + (.tool_input.file_path // "unknown")' >> kb/.logs/tools.log 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if [[ -d kb ]]; then jq -r '"[" + (now | todate) + "] Read: " + (.tool_input.file_path // "unknown")' >> kb/.logs/reads.log 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if [[ -d kb/.logs ]]; then echo "[$(date -Iseconds)] Session ended" >> kb/.logs/session.log 2>/dev/null || true; fi
